Scan Search Match Review

01 / 04

Scan the photos you choose.

Give Nimby access to your gallery, an album, or a few photos. It builds the search index right on your phone.

02 / 04

Search with a detail you remember.

Type “electricity bill,” a word from a screenshot, or when you took the photo. Recall searches the photos you’ve scanned.

03 / 04

See why it matched.

Nimby shows what brought each result back. Here, it found “electricity bill” in the text of two photos.

04 / 04

Open the original.

Check the bill and mark it as a keeper. You can also review duplicate photos and archive extras when you’re ready.

Pick up where you left off.

Compare what you saved

Put saved products side by side. Read a screenshot, check the product name, and look for buying links when you’re ready.

Follow up on receipts

Keep a receipt for reimbursement or set a reminder for a return. You choose when to be notified.

Review duplicates

See similar photos together and choose which to keep. Archiving hides extras in Nimby and leaves the originals in your gallery.

Your photos stay on your phone.

Nimby analyzes and searches photos on your device. Map locations are opt-in. When you ask for buying links, the search provider receives only the product query you approve.
